info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List File Payment Report Files-spec
info.description: The File Payment Report Retrieval API allows users to access detailed payment report files associated with specific file payment submissions. By leveraging the API, financial institutions and developers can obtain essential insights and documentation related to their transactions. It is particularly useful for stakeholders who require transparency and compliance in their payment processes, such as auditors and finance teams. This endpoint facilitates the retrieval of reports using a unique identifier, allowing for efficient tracking and analysis of payment activities.

get.summary: Retrieve report file for payment PAY-300045.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the report file associated with payment ID PAY-300045. It provides detailed information regarding the transaction, including status, amounts, and other relevant data, enabling effective tracking and reconciliation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details necessary for retrieving the report file for the specified payment operation. It contains all required parameters as defined in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested report file.

ListFilePaymentReportFilesRequest.description: A string representing the content of the request body for the GET operation concerning the specified report file.
